name: pi-dashboard-web-assets
description: Build-time only - compiles src/input.css (Tailwind) into style.css. Never runs at container runtime; nginx just serves the compiled output as a static file. "type": "module" here just tells Node's own tooling that src/**/*.js are ES modules (matches the <script type="module"> they're loaded as in the browser, see auth.js) - has no effect on the Tailwind build itself.
